description: This file contains functions for managing notes, including CRUD operations, liking, bookmarking, and fetching notes from a database via the Supabase client.

methods.name: insertNote({ title, description, subject = null, tags = [], file_path, file_url, user_id })
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the 'notes' table with provided details.

methods.name: fetchNotes({ q = '', tag = '', sort = 'created_at_desc', limit = 12, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes with optional search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: fetchNoteById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single note from the database by its id.

methods.name: toggleLike(noteId, isToggle, userId)
methods.description: Toggles a like for a note by a user, updating the likes count.

methods.name: toggleBookmark(noteId, isToggle, userId)
methods.description: Toggles a bookmark for a note by a user, updating the bookmarks count.

methods.name: fetchUserNotes(userId)
methods.description: Fetches all notes created by a specific user.

methods.name: deleteNote(noteId, userId)
methods.description: Deletes a note if the user owns it.
